rules.name: AWACS Range Positioning
rules.description: AWACS should be positioned for optimal radar coverage (not too close to action)

rules.name: AWACS Frequency Standard
rules.description: AWACS should broadcast standard surveillance frequency 305.00 MHz

rules.name: AWACS High Altitude Standard
rules.description: AWACS should fly at minimum 30,000 feet for maximum radar coverage

rules.name: AWACS Sufficient Waypoints
rules.description: AWACS should have minimum 2 waypoints for reasonable orbit pattern

rules.name: AWACS Orbit Pattern Required
rules.description: AWACS must have Orbit or Race-track action on waypoints to loiter for air superiority coverage

rules.name: AWACS Advanced Options Required
rules.description: AWACS should have unlimited fuel, invincible, and invisible settings for operational longevity
